decisions.reason: As the XL package disappeared from the website after launch, its standalone demand now looks sufficiently revealed as limited, so we would stop carrying it as a separate option and reallocate resources to stronger core modules.

Because this support service was promoted in 2023 but no longer shown in 2024, and personnel-intensive services are costly to keep open, we would abandon it and focus support capacity on the broader installed base.

This materials management module is a recent, close-to-core extension whose market potential is still uncertain but plausible, so the option value of keeping it on the market for another period remains attractive.

The secure healthcare messaging service fits regulation-driven digital workflows and was still actively presented with a major update in 2024, so we would keep investing while its strategic value continues to unfold.
